description: Hard limits this project depends on and does not control. Each row names the meter that measures current use against the limit, or UNMETERED when none exists. A meter is either test:<TestName> (a Test function in a *_test.go file in the tree) or ci:<workflow path>#<step or job name> (an uncommented name: line in the workflow file equals that name). A meter entry proves the named check exists, not that it enforces the limit. Checked by internal/architest/limits_register_test.go.

rows.limit: Go module zip size (cmd/go refuses to build a module zip above this)
rows.value: 500 MiB (524288000 bytes), uncompressed sum of module files
rows.breaks: go install <module>@latest silently keeps resolving to the last tag under the cap; users see no error
meters: ci:.github/workflows/ci.yml#module zip builds (what go install compiles)
rows.budget: 375 MiB ratchet for the root module (moduleZipBudgetBytes); 190 MiB non-Go ratchet (moduleZipNonGoBudget)

rows.limit: GitHub maximum size of a single file in a push
rows.breaks: git push is rejected for the oversized blob; the landing fails at push time
rows.evidence: no in-repo meter; the 5 MiB per-file ratchet at internal/architest/module_zip_budget_test.go:28 is self-imposed and does not measure this limit

rows.limit: GitHub Actions cache storage per repository
rows.breaks: once exceeded, the oldest caches are evicted; CI goes cold and slower with no red
rows.evidence: actions/cache used in .github/workflows/ci.yml (3 uses) and .github/workflows/ci-fast.yml (2 uses); no size meter

rows.breaks: gh release upload fails for an oversized asset; the release job goes red at upload
